data.name: low
text:
cementing_issue (low)
page: MOR-007_DDR_2021-02-21.pdf#p1
cause: Excessive cement losses to formation while cementing across Girujan.
remedy: Staged cement job with lightweight lead slurry and full tail string.
NPT: 1.56 h

mud_loss (low)
page: MOR-007_DDR_2021-02-23.pdf#p1
cause: Losses seen while running casing through Tipam, static losses continuing on connections.
remedy: Spotted 87 bbl high-fluid-loss pill across the loss zone and monitored pit levels.
NPT: 1.35 h

torque_spike (low)
page: MOR-007_DDR_2021-02-28.pdf#p1
cause: Sharp torque increase on contact with Basement, ROP dropped to near zero.
remedy: Reduced WOB and RPM, reamed interval, resumed drilling at reduced parameters.
NPT: 1.16 h

data.name: critical
text:
mud_loss (critical)
page: MOR-007_DDR_2021-02-24.pdf#p1
cause: Lost circulation 56 bbl/hr while drilling Tipam sand, partial returns only.
remedy: Pumped 117 bbl LCM pill, reduced ROP, regained partial returns.
NPT: 11.95 h

data.name: medium
text:
cementing_issue (medium)
page: MOR-007_DDR_2021-02-24.pdf#p1
cause: Poor cement bond / losses during primary cementing of casing shoe in Barail.
remedy: Squeeze cemented shoe track, pressure tested to spec before drilling out.
NPT: 15.98 h

overpressure (medium)
page: MOR-007_DDR_2021-02-24.pdf#p1
cause: SPP trend increasing and drag rising while drilling into Barail, suspected transition zone.
remedy: Raised mud weight in 52-ppg steps, monitored trip gas, continued drilling with caution.
NPT: 6.92 h

overpressure (medium)
page: MOR-007_DDR_2021-02-25.pdf#p1
cause: Well kicked back while circulating out of Barail, gas readings elevated on trip gas.
remedy: Weighted mud up to balance formation pressure, circulated bottoms up before resuming.
NPT: 4.51 h

data.name: high
text:
stuck_pipe (high)
page: MOR-007_DDR_2021-02-24.pdf#p1
cause: Differential sticking in Barail, no rotation or reciprocation possible.
remedy: Reduced mud weight, spotted spotting fluid across pay zone, freed string on jarring.
NPT: 17.65 h

kick (high)
page: MOR-007_DDR_2021-02-25.pdf#p1
cause: Gas-cut mud and increasing pit volume observed drilling Barail, well flowing.
remedy: Hard shut-in, recorded SIDPP/SICP, weighted up mud and circulated bottoms up.
NPT: 10.55 h

kick (high)
page: MOR-007_DDR_2021-02-26.pdf#p1
cause: Flow-check positive, pit gain of 95 bbl and flow-out exceeding flow-in while in Barail.
remedy: Shut in well, closed BOP, circulated kill mud per driller's method.
NPT: 7.82 h

data.name: medium
text:
stuck_pipe (medium)
page: MOR-004_DDR_2021-11-17.pdf#p1
cause: Pipe stuck while tripping through Girujan, unable to work free, torque and drag increasing prior to stick.
remedy: Worked pipe with max overpull, spotted 54 bbl pipe-lax pill, freed after 5.8 hrs.
NPT: 5.84 h

data.name: low
text:
mud_loss (low)
page: MOR-004_DDR_2021-11-18.pdf#p1
cause: Total losses encountered in Tipam, no returns to surface for 1.7 hrs.
remedy: Pumped cement plug to seal loss zone, waited on cement, tested integrity before resuming.
NPT: 1.71 h

mud_loss (low)
page: MOR-004_DDR_2021-11-22.pdf#p1
cause: Lost circulation 67 bbl/hr while drilling Sylhet sand, partial returns only.
remedy: Pumped 65 bbl LCM pill, reduced ROP, regained partial returns.
NPT: 3.26 h

text:
kick (high)
page: MOR-004_DDR_2021-11-21.pdf#p1
cause: Flow-check positive, pit gain of 30 bbl and flow-out exceeding flow-in while in Kopili.
